name: Tᴀᴜ Flight Simulator 1.0
author: Tau
description: A physics-based flight simulator: reach the runway, then learn to land and shake off missiles by flying low. Arrows for yaw and throttle; pitch and roll use a second gamepad.

descriptions.en: A physics-based flight simulator: reach the runway, then learn to land and shake off missiles by flying low. Arrows for yaw and throttle; pitch and roll use a second gamepad.
descriptions.it: Simulatore di volo basato sulla fisica: raggiungi la pista, impara ad atterrare e semina i missili volando basso. Frecce per imbardata e motore; beccheggio e rollio sul secondo joypad.
